Legal.agbIntro: Scope: These terms apply to all orders through the online shop of {companyLegalName}.
Legal.privacyIntro: Privacy: The protection of your personal data is very important to us. We adhere to the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revDSG / FADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Legal.imprintDisclaimer: Note: Set all COMPANY_* environment variables with real company data before go-live.
Legal.agbSec1Text: {companyLegalName} sells wall panels and related products to customers in Switzerland and selected neighbouring countries where offered.
Legal.agbSec2Text: Placing an order constitutes a binding offer. The contract is formed when {companyLegalName} confirms the order by email.
Legal.agbSec3Text: All prices are in CHF including statutory VAT. Payment is processed via Stripe. {companyLegalName} does not store full card details.
Legal.agbSec4Text: Delivery is made to your specified address. Shipping costs and times are shown at checkout. {companyShippingPolicy}
Legal.agbSec5Text: Consumers have a statutory right of withdrawal for distance contracts. The full terms, withdrawal period, procedure and model form are set out on our separate Right of Withdrawal page (/widerruf), which forms part of these terms by reference.
Legal.privacySec1Text:
We collect and process personal data that you provide when registering, ordering, contacting us or subscribing to our newsletter:
• Identity & contact: name, email, phone, delivery/billing address
• Account: login credentials (password stored hashed), language preference
• Order: products, quantities, prices, payment status, order history
• Communication: messages sent via contact forms or support
• Technical: IP address (short-term), browser type, consent choices
• Payment: transaction references via Stripe (no full card numbers on our servers)
Legal.privacySec2Text:
We process your data to:
• Fulfil and deliver orders and process payments
• Manage your customer account and wishlist
• Send transactional emails (order confirmation, shipping, password reset)
• Respond to enquiries and provide customer support
• Comply with legal obligations (tax, accounting, consumer law)
• Improve our website (only with your analytics consent)
• Send marketing communications (only with your explicit consent)
Legal.privacySec3Text: Processing is based on contract performance (orders), legitimate interests (security, fraud prevention), legal obligations (Swiss commercial and tax law) and, where required, your consent (newsletter, non-essential cookies, marketing).
Legal.privacySec4Text:
We share data only when necessary with:
• Stripe — payment processing
• Postmark — transactional email
• Cloudflare R2 — product images
• Hosting provider: {companyHostingProvider}
Legal.privacySec5Text: Some providers process data outside Switzerland/EU. Contact {companyPrivacyEmail} for details.
Legal.privacySec6Text:
We use:
• Necessary cookies: shopping cart session, authentication, security (always active)
• Analytics cookies: usage statistics (only with your consent)
• Marketing cookies: campaign measurement (only with your consent)
You can change your choices at any time via the cookie settings. Consent decisions are logged with a timestamp for compliance purposes.
Legal.widerrufIntro: Consumers may withdraw from distance contracts with {companyLegalName} under the conditions below.
Legal.widerrufSec1Text: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period is 14 days from the day on which you or a third party named by you, who is not the carrier, take possession of the goods.
Legal.widerrufSec3Text: If you withdraw, we shall reimburse all payments received from you, including delivery costs (except additional costs if you chose a delivery method other than standard delivery), without undue delay and no later than 14 days from receipt of your withdrawal notice. We use the same payment method you used for the original transaction unless otherwise agreed. We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or proof of return shipment.
Legal.widerrufSec4Text: Return goods within 14 days at your cost. {companyProductReturnPolicy}
Legal.widerrufSec5Text:
Right of withdrawal does not apply to:
• Custom-made goods
• Sealed hygiene products once opened
• {companyProductExclusions}
